description: This file defines the SiloAddress class, which encapsulates details of silo network addresses within the Orleans distributed application framework. It provides methods for creating, parsing, and comparing silo addresses, along with serialization and hashing utilities. Additionally, it includes a JSON converter for SiloAddress instances.

classes.name: SiloAddress
classes.description: A data class representing a silo's network address, including methods for creation, parsing, comparison, hashing, and serialization. It handles IP address normalization, generation tracking, and provides utilities for consistent hashing and address comparison.

classes.name: SiloAddressConverter
classes.description: A JSON converter class for serializing and deserializing SiloAddress instances to and from JSON string representations.

methods.name: SiloAddress.New
methods.description: Factory method to create a new SiloAddress from an IP endpoint or IP address, with interned cache to prevent duplicates.

methods.name: SiloAddress.FromParsableString
methods.description: Parses a SiloAddress from its string representation, reconstructing the address and generation.

methods.name: SiloAddress.FromUtf8String
methods.description: Parses a SiloAddress from its UTF8 byte array representation.

methods.name: SiloAddress.ToParsableString
methods.description: Returns a standard string representation of the SiloAddress, suitable for parsing later.

methods.name: SiloAddress.ToUtf8String
methods.description: Returns a UTF8-encoded byte array representing the SiloAddress.

methods.name: SiloAddress.GetConsistentHashCode
methods.description: Computes a consistent hash code for load balancing and consistent hashing algorithms.

methods.name: SiloAddress.CompareTo
methods.description: Compares this SiloAddress to another for ordering based on generation, port, and IP address.

methods.name: SiloAddress.GetUniformHashCodes
methods.description: Generates a list of hash codes for consistent hashing.

methods.name: SiloAddress.Matches
methods.description: Determines if two addresses are considered matching based on IP, port, and generation.

methods.name: SiloAddress.IsSameLogicalSilo
methods.description: Checks if two addresses refer to the same logical silo, ignoring generation differences.

methods.name: SiloAddress.IsSuccessorOf
methods.description: Checks if this address is a successor of another (same silo, higher generation).

methods.name: SiloAddress.IsPredecessorOf
methods.description: Checks if this address is a predecessor of another (same silo, lower generation).
